description: [WRITE] Create a Spotify Ads Conversion API SERVER tag from the Stape template (stape-io/spotify-tag), imported automatically. Needs authToken and connectionId. Omit `event` to inherit; Page_View/Sign_Up/Lead/View_Product/Add_Cart/Start_Checkout/Purchase or a GA4 name are standard, custom_event_1..5 are the only custom slots (anything else inherits). eventId is the dedup row. containerId must be the SERVER container. Needs a SERVER trigger (triggers_create) passed as firingTriggerId. Requires GTM_MCP_ENABLE_WRITES=true and confirm=true.

authToken.description: Spotify Ads authentication token, usually a {{variable}} so it is not stored in plain text on the tag.

confirm.description: Must be true to confirm this write operation.

containerId.description: The SERVER container ID (for the plan tool: the WEB container).

eventDetails.description: Override rows {name, value}; names are the template's own field keys.

firingTriggerId.description: SERVER trigger id(s) the tag fires on (triggers_create, type customEvent). Usually one.

name.description: Tag name; defaults to "Spotify CAPI Tag".

serverEventData.description: Override rows {name, value}; names are the template's own field keys.

userData.description: Override rows {name, value}; names are the template's own field keys.

name: create_spotify_capi_server_tag
